An independent reader judged the previous rewrite of this lesson. Fix everything below as well. Each item is as serious as an item under "Fix these".

### Findings

1. Rule L02 (Major). Problem: This long formal definition is not simple Grade 5 teaching prose.
   > A **conflict of interest** exists when an official or employee is a board member, officer, substantial stockholder, owner, or person with a substantial business interest, and that private interest may oppose or be affected by faithful performance of official duty.
2. Rule L25 (Major). Problem: Honorary capacity controls an exemption but is never explained.
   > The SALN filing rule does not cover people who serve only in an honorary capacity, laborers, or casual or temporary workers.

Reason: Example 3 already covers retention; the destroy-unless-investigation exception can be added as a sentence.
